LESSON: DIVISIONS OF THE QUR’AN MADINAN SURAH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an 1.1 Modes of preservation of the Qur’an (4 lessons) By the end of the sub
Topic 1.2: Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do the divisions of the Qur’an help in studying it?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing
2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an
3. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah in the examples.
2. Explain Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
4. Show that you can: explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the divisions of the Qur’an and make charts and display,
2. Unity is enhanced as learners discuss the divisions of the Qur’an in groups.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing
2. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an
3. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
